target_customer: Engineering and data teams that connect AI coding agents and assistants (Cursor, Claude) to production Postgres databases
problem: Connecting AI agents directly to databases risks destructive queries and leaks of customer records. Midplane checks each SQL statement against policy, hides sensitive fields and logs activity.
business_model: Open source (MIT) gateway with a paid hosted Midplane Cloud tier adding team approvals, SSO and shared rules
product_category: AI agent database access control (MCP gateway for Postgres)

founders.name: Dustin Lange
prior_employers: Amazon (8.5 years, Machine Learning Scientist and Applied Science Manager)
education: Hasso Plattner Institute, Potsdam, PhD in database systems
previous_startups: Deekard (listed on the YC page, tie to the founders not stated)
founders.background_notes: Founded an Amazon team building data quality tools including Deequ.

founders.name: Tammo Rukat
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the IvyCheck launch post on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: SQL parsing, per table policy, redaction and audit logging for an MCP server is standard but security sensitive engineering, and the founders have deep data quality experience from Amazon.

defensibility.rationale: The core is MIT licensed and easy to copy. Enterprise features such as SSO and approvals in the hosted tier are the only lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown. Current sources show new funded entrants in agent data access guardrails, but nothing dated to the batch.

market_need_then: No evidence of demand in mid 2022 was found for the current product. The YC page lists earlier launches by the founders (IvyCheck) around text classification and prompt injection protection, so the present description reflects a later period.

branding.domain_note: Uses midplane.ai per the company site. Acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise. Tagline: Ask your Postgres database anything. Break nothing.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Ask your Postgres database anything. Break nothing.

brand_strength.rationale: A new, small brand with only a GitHub organization and an npm package found. Search surfaced unrelated companies such as Mailplane and Plane.

outcome_analysis: Midplane is a two person Berlin team of former Amazon scientists that is active as of the sources found. Its current product, an open source safety gateway between AI agents and Postgres, fits a recent agent adoption wave, but no funding beyond YC, no revenue and no customers were found, so the outcome is too early and too thinly documented to call.
